allowed_claim_if_success: directionally concordant in a small independent paired cohort
claim_if_not_success: not directionally concordant in the independent cohort

success_rule: Cancer-versus-Normal ECM score positive and P<0.05
claim_if_not_success: directionally evaluated but not statistically supported

claim_if_not_success: spatial evidence was inconsistent or non-confirmatory

success_rule: ECM score decreases in at least 2 of 3 patient-level contrasts
allowed_claim_if_success: directionally compatible but non-confirmatory perturbation response

success_rule: at least 10 signature proteins detected and signed enrichment is reported without cherry-picking
claim_if_not_success: protein-level coverage or direction was limited

success_rule: score HR>1 and likelihood-ratio P<0.05 after non-overlapping CAF proxy
allowed_claim_if_success: adds information beyond a CAF abundance proxy
claim_if_not_success: did not show detectable incremental information beyond the modeled CAF proxy

success_rule: empirical P<0.05 for the observed clinical statistic
claim_if_not_success: did not outperform matched random gene sets
